projects.title: GDS-ParT
projects.short: Jet-tagging transformer with pairwise-physics gating; 84.84% acc on JetClass
projects.description: Gated dual-stream particle transformer for jet tagging: pairwise physics gates attention queries/keys. 84.84% accuracy, AUC 0.9853 on JetClass. PyTorch.

projects.title: GDS-ParT-MoE
projects.short: Mixture-of-Experts particle transformer; what physics each expert learns
projects.description: Per-particle Mixture-of-Experts for GDS-ParT on JetClass: sparse upcycling and expert interpretability via mutual information and knockout. PyTorch.

projects.title: PLE Lab
projects.short: Gemma-3n-inspired per-layer embeddings on a small TinyStories GPT
projects.description: Small-scale per-layer embeddings (PLE) experiment inspired by Gemma 3n: TinyStories GPT, PLE-table offload benchmarks (GPU/CPU/mmap) and a token explorer.

projects.title: LLM-NAS
projects.short: LLM-guided vs random architecture search on CIFAR-10 (one recorded run)
projects.description: Single-run comparison of LLM-guided (Ollama Qwen2.5-Coder 3B) and random neural architecture search on CIFAR-10 in PyTorch, with recorded results.

projects.title: JetClass Particle Visualizer
projects.short: Particle-cloud plots, heatmaps and event displays for JetClass jets
projects.description: Plotting pipeline for JetClass jets: 2D/3D particle clouds, class-averaged heatmaps, energy spectra, radial profiles and event displays. uproot, plotly.

projects.title: AnaTele
projects.short: ArduPilot flight-log crash investigation with 3D replay and diagnostics
projects.description: Drone crash investigation for ArduPilot flight logs (.tlog/.bin): 3D flight replay, compass/EKF, vibration and motor diagnostics, ranked crash hypotheses.

projects.title: Asclepius (NIDAR RescueSwarm)
projects.short: Coverage planning and ArduPilot missions for a search-and-rescue drone swarm
projects.description: Search-and-rescue drone swarm tooling for NIDAR RescueSwarm: nadir-camera coverage path planning, ArduPilot mission export, fleet tools, YOLO-World detection.

projects.title: Lunar PSR Rover (ISRO BAH 2026)
projects.short: Chandrayaan-2 DFSAR ice mapping, landing site and rover path (hackathon)
projects.description: Lunar south pole subsurface ice mapping from Chandrayaan-2 DFSAR polarimetry: ice volume estimate, landing-site selection, A* rover path. ISRO hackathon 2026.

projects.title: Rotating Detonation Engine atlas
projects.short: Conceptual RDE project atlas, plan and 3D WebGL viewer (not a design)
projects.description: Conceptual planning and visualisation materials for a university rotating detonation engine demonstrator: project atlas, schedule, PlayCanvas 3D viewer.

projects.title: Agnostos (CLI)
projects.short: CLI that matches professors to your resume and sends paced cold emails
projects.description: Research internship cold-email CLI: finds professors matching your resume, drafts personalised emails, sends them paced from your inbox, tracks replies.

projects.title: Agnostos (web app)
projects.short: Self-hosted web app version of Agnostos for research outreach
projects.description: Self-hosted web app for research internship outreach: find professors, draft emails, send paced from your inbox, handle replies. FastAPI. No public instance.

projects.title: ToggleCV
projects.short: GitHub repos to reviewed LaTeX CV project bullets via a YAML toggle file
projects.description: CLI that turns your GitHub repos into a YAML toggle file and writes the Projects section of your LaTeX CV, with reviewed Result/Action/Context bullets.

projects.title: Sci-Synth
projects.short: Browser extension that explains scientific PDFs with your own AI provider; opt-in viewer
projects.description: Browser extension (MV3) that explains scientific PDFs: hold Alt over text, equations or figures and ask your own AI provider. Opt-in viewer, no analytics.

projects.title: e-Raksha hackathon prototype
projects.short: Network flow capture and anomaly-detection prototype (hackathon)
projects.description: Hackathon prototype for network monitoring: Scapy flow capture, simulated IoT traffic, Isolation Forest anomaly detection, SQLite and a Flask dashboard.

projects.title: Colour-based object tracking
projects.short: OpenCV colour-mask tracking with trajectory and velocity plots
projects.description: OpenCV object tracking by colour: HSV masking, contours and convex hull centroid to plot a trajectory and velocity from a video. Early learning project.
